nodes.question: What were the key findings of the segmentation analysis conducted by Former and Romani (2021) in the context of plastics?
nodes.answer: Former and Romani (2021) identified four distinct clusters of individuals based on their attitudes towards different sources and impacts of plastic litter. They also found that gender, education, and location significantly influenced respondents' opinions, knowledge, and behaviours related to plastics.
